channelTitle: That tender spot under your jaw? Grandma June has a two-minute trick
hook: Feeling tender, swollen spots under your jaw when you're coming down with something, what actually helps besides waiting it out?
remedy: Holding a warm, damp cloth gently against swollen glands under the jaw or neck is an old home comfort measure some families used to ease tenderness while the body fights off a cold.
steps: Soak a soft cloth in warm water and wring it out
Hold it gently against the tender area under the jaw for ten minutes
Repeat a few times a day as needed while symptoms last
caution: See a doctor if swollen glands are very hard, don't move under the skin, last more than two weeks, or come with a high fever.
cta: Does warmth help you too, or do you have a different comfort trick? Tell Grandma June below.
